label: Surrogate error
subgoals: Compute the absolute percentage error against SPICE
Measure error on held-out designs from the region being searched
Re-measure as the search moves to new regions

label: The speed-up budget
subgoals: Write the mixed cost as surrogate calls plus verified SPICE runs
Divide the all-SPICE cost by the mixed cost
Reduce the number of candidates that need SPICE

label: False accepts and guard bands
subgoals: Count candidates the surrogate passes and SPICE fails
Forward only predictions that clear the spec by a guard band
Tune the guard band to the measured local error and keep SPICE as judge
